tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Developer | Java, Spring, REST APIs & Enterprise Architectures
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: (SENIOR) TECHNICAL ARCHITECT - SALESFORCE COMMERCE CLOUD (M/F/D)
cover_en.hook: Bringing my passion for high-performance e-commerce and deep technical expertise to Canyon aligns perfectly with your innovative digital ecosystem in Barcelona. Over the past 5+ years building and scaling enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have driven complex backend architectures and API transformations.

bullets.label: API-First Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, executing the transition of enterprise e-commerce platforms toward decoupled, API-driven architectures.

bullets.label: Requirement Analysis & Technical Design
bullets.text: Carried out continuous analysis of business requirements, breaking down user stories into robust technical concepts, data models, and system integration strategies.

bullets.label: Quality, Governance & Code Reviews
bullets.text: Acted as final authority for technical reviews, enforcing high-quality coding standards, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines across distributed development teams.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Mentoring
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance, onboarding, and code reviews for international engineering squads, aligning team outputs with long-term platform scalability goals.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 and am available to start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my architectural and integration expertise can support Canyon's continued growth.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at Canyon because your direct-to-consumer model at the cutting edge of the bike industry demands robust, scalable, and innovative e-commerce architectures. Contributing to your global tech hub in Barcelona allows me to combine my deep backend and API integration experience with a collaborative, international team dedicated to crafting exceptional digital brand experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving enterprise e-commerce transformation through robust API-first architectures, technical governance, and cross-functional leadership.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Canyon Hiring Team, with 5+ years designing enterprise e-commerce backends, REST APIs, and leading technical deliveries at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very excited about your Senior Technical Architect role in Barcelona. My CV and cover letter are attached!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for (SENIOR) TECHNICAL ARCHITECT - SALESFORCE COMMERCE CLOUD (M/F/D) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the (Senior) Technical Architect position at Canyon.

With over 5 years of experience architecting enterprise e-commerce platforms, building headless REST APIs, establishing CI/CD governance, and leading technical teams at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to your tech hub in Barcelona.

I hold a valid German residence permit, am serving my notice period with a final working day on 15.12.2026, and can start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
